nodes.name: Schedule Every 10 Min
nodes.notes: Internal n8n trigger to resume lead discovery & contact collection batches every 10 minutes.

nodes.name: Check Status & Overlap Lock
nodes.notes: Reads current checkpoint state to detect if a batch is already running and prevent overlapping jobs.

nodes.name: Execute Lead Batch
nodes.notes: Executes 20-company batch: backlog crawl, contact page extraction, deterministic qualification, and staging.

parameters.jsCode:
const b = $json;
return [{
  json: {
    batch_id: b.batch_id || 'unknown',
    status: b.status || 'unknown',
    duration_seconds: b.duration_seconds || 0,
    source_type: b.source_type || 'backlog',
    checkpoint_before: b.checkpoint_before || '',
    checkpoint_after: b.checkpoint_after || '',
    businesses_found: b.businesses_found || 0,
    sites_accessed: b.sites_accessed || 0,
    sites_failed: b.sites_failed || 0,
    public_emails_found: b.public_emails_found || 0,
    unique_validated_emails: b.unique_validated_emails || 0,
    leads_stored: b.leads_stored || 0,
    outreach_ready_added: b.outreach_ready_added || 0,
    drafts_prepared: b.drafts_prepared || 0,
    duplicates_rejected: b.duplicates_rejected || 0,
    errors: b.errors || []
  }
}];

parameters.query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT count(*) FROM companies WHERE active) as total_companies,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM companies WHERE outreach_status = 'outreach_ready') as outreach_ready,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM contacts) as total_contacts,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM outreach_queue WHERE campaign = 'google_reviews_maps_299') as staged_drafts,
  (SELECT items_processed FROM lead_engine_checkpoint WHERE checkpoint_id = 'primary_lead_pipeline') as checkpoint_items_processed;
